VBO:0200797.summary: Playful and fond of squeaky toys, Georgie is described by Animal House Shelter as a Labrador–Shar-Pei mix that also enjoys cuddles and food rewards. Parkland Humane Society describes its young Lab Pei Maree as outgoing, keen on attention and vocal. The Lab Pei name refers to a Labrador Retriever–Shar-Pei cross.
VBO:0200797.shortDescription: In Animal House Shelter’s account, Georgie, identified as a Labrador–Shar-Pei mix, is playful and fond of toys and cuddles.
